# Feature checklist (small features inside an existing module)

- [ ] SPEC section updated first (version line, deviation entry if behavior changed)
- [ ] Contracts, locales (en, ar), error codes
- [ ] Server route, permission declared, audit entry
- [ ] Web screen, copy via t(), semantic theme tokens
- [ ] Tests: unit, route integration, e2e step (docs/TESTING-PLAN.md section 4)
- [ ] PROGRESS.md and docs/features/REGISTRY.md updated
- [ ] Conventional Commit, scope = module
